title: fix(plugin-form): ModalForm holds its loading state until the first record read lands (#10659)
body:
Fixes #10659
Clause-②: no
The modal edit arm begins holding its loading state until the first record read lands, as the drawer twin already does; no export, schema or accept set moves.

## What

`ModalForm` no longer paints an editable form while its FIRST record read is in flight. Its field-building effect now ends the loading state only when no record read is outstanding. That is the gate objectui#10256 gave `DrawerForm` for objectui#10190. A load the fetch effect started is ended by the fetch effect.

The gate is lifted into ONE shared predicate, `isRecordReadOutstanding` (new file `packages/plugin-form/src/recordReadGate.ts`), and both containers call it. `DrawerForm`'s inline copy of the condition is replaced by the call. Its `endLoading` closure stays per arm, because it closes over each component's own `setLoading`.

Why one helper and not a second inline copy: the drawer and modal pair has drifted before when each carried its own copy of a shared step (objectui#4755, the flat-field builder). "Is a record read outstanding" is exactly the condition that must stay identical in both. Ablation A3 below shows both arms now hang off the same predicate.

## Mechanism, measured

Measured through `ObjectForm` with `formType: 'modal'` in edit mode and `findOne` held open by a deferred promise. The test types `Mine v2` into the first input the form offers, releases the read, and submits. At base `0c3f70aae` (pin committed, fix absent):

| arm / shape | editable input while the read is held | `update` payload |
|:--|:--|:--|
| modal / flat | yes | `{ name: 'Mine', stage: 'open' }`: the whole record, original values |
| modal / sections | yes | the same |
| drawer / flat (control) | no | `{ name: 'Mine v2' }` |
| drawer / sections (control) | no | `{ name: 'Mine v2' }` |

The modal payload is the shape CI received in run `36147629257`: the typed value is gone and every business column is sent with its read value, under the right `ifMatch`. The landing record reset the form, and the save then compared the record with itself, found nothing changed, and sent the full payload.

## The other arms

Measured with the same harness at base, `sections` shape through `ObjectForm`: `tabbed`, `split` and `wizard` offer no editable input while the read is held, and each submits exactly `{ name: 'Mine v2' }` (`Tests 6 passed (6)`). The same harness is red on the modal, so it can fail. None of the three has a fields effect that ends the loading state; their only enders sit on the read path, or on branches that cannot run while a read is outstanding (for example, no data source). No edit there. The probe was a temporary file and is not committed.

## Tests

- New pin `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/modalFirstLoadWindow-10659.test.tsx`. It drives `ObjectForm` with `formType` modal, and drawer as the control, in the flat and the sectioned shape. Each combination has two rows: "offers no editable input while the first record read is in flight", and "a value typed into the first input the form offers is the value submitted", which asserts the exact `update` call and a single `findOne`. A modal create-mode row is the boundary.
  - Red on base `0c3f70aae`: `Tests 4 failed | 5 passed (9)`, the four modal rows. The drawer and create rows are green.
  - Green on head: all 9 rows pass. The pin is one of the 126 files in the package run below.
- The existing `editDirtyPayload-10156` `describe.each` modal row is unchanged, and it can no longer race. Its `fieldEl` waits for `input[name="name"]`. `ModalForm` now mounts no input until the fetch effect's own continuation has set `formData` to the read record and ended the loading state, so the first input the row can find already holds the record. The record is read once (the new pin asserts a single `findOne`), so no later landing can replace the typed value. The race it lost in CI needed an input mounted before the read landed, and that input no longer exists.
- Per-hunk ablation, from committed HEAD `09574c373`, through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode inside a trap script. Each anchor hit x1 and went to x0, and the tool proved each blob change and each restore on disk.
  - A1, the modal `sections` branch `endLoading()` put back to `setLoading(false)`: `Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9)`, exactly the two modal/sections rows.
  - A2, the modal flat branch `endLoading()` put back to `setLoading(false)`: `Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9)`, exactly the two modal/flat rows.
  - A3, the shared predicate's last clause replaced with `false`: `Tests 8 failed | 1 passed (9)`, every modal AND drawer edit row. The create row stays green.
  - Restore: blob equals HEAD for both files, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Local results at HEAD `09574c373`, the merge of `origin/main` `4df0f3d9d` (which carries objectui#10670):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` from the repo root: `Test Files 126 passed (126)`, `Tests 1385 passed | 1 skipped (1386)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build`). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin and `recordReadGate.ts`.
- eslint on the four changed files (`--format json`, 4 files, 0 errors): `ModalForm.tsx` 20 and `DrawerForm.tsx` 22 warnings, the same by rule as at `origin/main`; `recordReadGate.ts` 0; the new test 4 (`no-explicit-any`). No type-aware linting is configured, so these files cannot move another file's verdict. Repo-wide lint is CI's.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check-type-check-coverage`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports` needs a whole-workspace build (it refused with 25 packages unbuilt). This diff moves no README and no export.
- Not run locally: the full `pnpm test` farm and repo-wide lint. Those are CI's.

## Published prose

No pending changeset, README or docs sentence says `ModalForm` paints before its read lands, so nothing is falsified and no dated note is needed. Checked: every pending changeset naming `ModalForm`, `recordReadOutstanding` or "first record read", `packages/plugin-form/README.md`, and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx`.

## Acceptance notes

- `fieldSecurityPayload.test.tsx`'s `editAllowedFieldAndSubmit` waits for the record to be on screen; objectui#10256 added that for the modal row. Neither overlay needs it now, but it is harmless and its comment is written generally, so it is left as is.
- Changeset: `.changeset/10659-modalform-first-load-window.md`, patch for `@object-ui/plugin-form`.
- Serial: objectui#10670 merged to `main` as `41dcbd541` while this branch was in flight. It is merged in with a merge commit and no conflict; the gate hunks sit away from its field-gate call.
